_doc: PAX-A13 trap kit AutoSprite specs (rulings §11 R3). The prompt sent is object + the style block for its background (static) or motion + the animation block. Ceilings are per-line credits including one retry; the tool refuses past a line's ceiling or 20 per asset. 2026-09-29: T07's first result added a human figure and blue water (AutoSprite's side-scroller pipeline assumes a character), so every animation prompt now ends with animation_negative and bases are uploaded with base_description.

style.M: Hand-painted 2D game sprite, strict side view. Golden backlight, gold rim light, warm brown shade, no black. No cyan, no text. On flat magenta #FF00FF.
style.B: Hand-painted 2D game effect, strict side view. Warm gold and cream, soft edges. No cyan, no text. On pure black #000000.
style.animation: Static camera: no zoom, pan or tilt; strict side view. Keep the exact painting style, colours, light and outline of the image. The base shape never moves or changes size; only the described motion happens.
style.animation_negative: Only the object in the image and this effect: no person, character, creature or figure. Water and light are warm gold and cream, never blue.

T01.name: arrow_launcher
T01.object: Carved sandstone arrow slot: square block face, dark mouth, bronze rim, bronze arrowhead just inside. Ancient temple trap, weathered.

T02.name: arrow
T02.object: One thin arrow pointing right: bronze leaf-shaped head, dark wood shaft, rust-red fletching. Very long and thin, 12x longer than tall.

T03.name: geyser_vent
T03.object: Stone floor vent: low carved sandstone ring, flat top, dark round mouth with faint warm glow, wet moss at the lip. 4x wider than tall.

T04.name: geyser_column
T04.object: Vertical jet of rushing water, straight, centred, fills the full height, seamless top to bottom: white-gold foam streaks, backlit spray, soft sides.

T05.name: debris_sheet
T05.object: Sheet of 8 separate small pieces, spaced apart: 4 broken sandstone chunks, 2 grit clusters, 2 wood splinters. Weathered, sunlit edges.

T06.name: softfx_sheet
T06.object: Sheet of 6 separate pieces, spaced apart: 3 soft round puffs of warm sandy dust, 3 small splashes of water droplets. Soft, no hard edges.

T07.name: geyser_tell
T07.motion: The vent starts to stir: water wells up and bubbles in the mouth, small droplets pop, thin wisps of warm steam rise a little and fade. Gentle, building slightly.

T08.name: geyser_burst
T08.motion: A powerful jet of water bursts straight up out of the vent's mouth and keeps gushing: foam and spray fly outward at the base and fall back. The jet leaves the top of the frame.

T09.name: spike_strip
T09.object: Row of sharp bronze spikes, worn and rust-stained, on a dark stone socket strip, seamless left to right. Clearly dangerous. 6x wider than tall.

T12.name: block_crack
T12.object: Overlay of thin jagged dark-brown hairline cracks spreading from the centre, nothing else, crisp. Square.

T13.name: spear
T13.object: One heavy spear pointing right: broad bronze head, thick dark wooden shaft, leather wrap near the head. Long and thin, 10x longer than tall.

T14.name: glyph_ring
T14.object: Ancient circular glyph ring of warm gold light: thin carved runic arc segments, soft glow, hollow centre. Square, centred.

T15.name: inverter_orb
T15.object: Glowing orb of warm gold light with a slow swirl inside and a soft halo, floating. Square, centred.

T16.name: cue_icon
T16.object: Simple glyph of two curved arrows chasing each other in a circle, warm gold light, bold readable shape. Square, centred.

T17.name: storm_cloud
T17.object: One heavy storm cloud, puffy golden-lit top, dark warm-grey belly, flat-ish bottom, soft edges. 2.5x wider than tall.

T18.name: scorch
T18.object: Flat scorch mark decal: dark warm-brown burnt streaks radiating from a centre, a few embers. Wide and low, 3x wider than tall.

T19.name: leaves_sparks
T19.object: Sheet of 8 separate small pieces, spaced apart: 4 green-gold leaves, 4 small bright gold sparks. Crisp.

T20.name: orb_flare
T20.motion: The orb flares: its glow swells brightly with a quick pulse of light rings expanding outward, then settles back to its calm glow.

T21.name: cloud_charge
T21.motion: The cloud darkens and churns: its belly roils, flickers of warm white light pulse inside it, and a gathering glow builds under it.

T22.name: vine_snap
T22.motion: The vine frays in the middle: fibres split and unravel, then it snaps in two; both ends whip apart and a few leaves fall away.

base_description: An inanimate carved sandstone floor vent set into the ground. It is an object, not a character: no person or creature.
